purpose: User-requested illustrated refinement and five-tab sheet with the existing inventory integrated

assets.prompt: Production reusable fantasy RPG UI material asset, a SINGLE wide horizontal 3:1 stat cartouche, no UI mockup. Hand-painted medieval illuminated manuscript, aged cream parchment #EAD5AC #F4E5C8 with fine watercolor fibres, carved dark walnut #493023 underneath, aged brass #B68A42 relief bevel, selective sculpted acanthus leaves at the far corners only. A restrained octagonal silhouette, corners clipped organically, 80% of interior blank and calm for real native text and icons. Border about 7% of image height, quiet straight middle strips suitable for nine-slice scaling. Gold is worn and painterly, not glossy. Transparent outside the single cartouche, no shadow beyond 3% margin. Completely frontal. No letters, numbers, text, runes, icons, characters or scene. Exquisite fantasy character-sheet component with material volume and clean reading area; not merely a thin golden rectangle.

assets.layout: 3 columns x 2 rows; runtime alpha cutoff 32/255 and trimmed regions; portrait center stays transparent
assets.prompt: Production fantasy RPG UI ORNAMENT ATLAS, exactly SIX ornaments in regular 3 columns x 2 rows, transparent background, centered equal square cells with generous 12% transparent padding, canvas aspect 3:2. Rich hand-painted medieval manuscript, carved walnut and sculpted antique brass with tiny ivory highlights and subtle moss-green watercolor leaves, fine warm ink outlines. Row1 left-right: ornate CIRCULAR PORTRAIT RING with fully transparent center; substantial HERALDIC SHIELD with blank calm parchment face for a native armor-class number; HEXAGONAL MODIFIER MEDALLION with blank parchment center for a native number. Row2 left-right: elegant ACANTHUS CORNER FLOURISH; small horizontal LEAF AND DIAMOND SEPARATOR; an ornamental OPEN BOOK and QUILL vignette on subtle cream watercolor. The first ring must have alpha-zero center, not a portrait. All ornaments independent, completely within their cells, same metal and wood family. NO letters, numerals, writing, runes, portraits, people, whole UI, stats or screenshot.

assets.layout: 5 columns x 3 rows; fifteen keyed regions; runtime alpha cutoff 32/255 and mipmaps

assets.layout: 1 column x 3 rows; individual nine-slice material regions with preserved ends
assets.prompt: Production fantasy RPG UI TITLE RIBBON ATLAS: THREE separate long horizontal blank ribbons stacked in a regular single-column three-row grid. Each ribbon has aspect about 5:1; canvas overall aspect 5:3. Transparent space around each ribbon, no shared background. Same hand-painted medieval illuminated manuscript family, aged brass, carved walnut, burgundy and cream. Top row: burgundy embossed leather title cartouche with curved clipped ends and selective brass leaf relief. Middle row: ivory rolled parchment title strip with a thin walnut backing and delicate brown ink scrollwork at the far ends. Bottom row: dark walnut title bar with narrow aged brass inlay and a subtle burgundy leather central inset, restrained heraldic leaf tips. Centers 75% blank and quiet to place native text later. Suitable for nine-slice stretching along calm horizontal middle, do not decorate the center. Materials painterly and artisanal with soft relief. NO text, letters, numbers, runes, labels, icons, people, background scene or complete UI.

One production fantasy RPG character-sheet decorative illustration, panoramic landscape 3:1, transparent background. A delicate sepia brown ink and muted watercolor vignette of distant layered mountains, a small medieval coastal keep on a rocky promontory, a few cypresses and oak leaves at the outer edges. Fine engraved pen lines, restrained cream ochre, grey-blue and forest green washes. Hand-painted medieval illuminated-manuscript illustration, calm and refined, not a map or a new canonical location. Lower edge and sky fade softly into transparent paper, no rectangular border, no frame. Intended as a small secondary illustration in a parchment character-sheet footer, so clear silhouette, quiet low contrast, no foreground clutter. NO text, lettering, labels, runes, characters, loot, UI controls or whole character sheet.
